g.text: Overtake
If your opponent holds the centre square,
take that stone off the board and back into
their hand.
A Mountain is not safe from it.
Moved second only — spend at the end of your turn.
Overtake
If your opponent holds the centre square,
take that stone off the board and back into
their hand.
A Mountain is not safe from it.
Moved second only — spend at the end of your turn.
Relocate
Move one of your own stones to any free
square.
It resolves nothing on arrival.
Moved second only — spend at the end of your turn.

Mirror
Swap what stands on two squares
symmetric about the centre.
Whoever owns the two stones.
Moved second only — spend at the end of your turn.
Mirror

symmetric about the centre.
Whoever owns the two stones.
Moved second only — spend at the end of your turn.
Mind Control
Name a stone in your opponent’s hand.
That is what they must play next turn.
You never touch the stone yourself.
Moved second only — spend at the end of your turn.

Rehearse
Resolve one of your stones on the board
again, from wherever it now stands.
Not one the space has switched off.
Moved second only — spend at the end of your turn.
